input_messages.content: Hello! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone for the past few hours. I would really like to fix this so I can send pictures to my family. Can you help me with that?
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith.
I don't want to change my plan, please. I think I would like to refuel data. Can you please add 2 GB for me?
I want to refuel 2 GB of data, but I am not sure how to proceed with the payment. Could you please help me add the 2 GB to my account?
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 GB of data to my account. Thank you.
I confirmed that you can add the 2 GB to my account and the charge will be added to my bill. Please proceed with adding the 2 GB of data now.
Thank you for adding the data. I will try sending a picture message now. Just a moment, please.
I tried sending a picture message, but it still won't send. What should I do next? I'm a bit worried because I really need to send these messages.

The status bar shows that Airplane Mode is on, and my battery is at 80%. The network status confirms that Airplane Mode is on, my SIM card is missing, there is no cellular connection or signal, mobile data is off, and Wi-Fi is off and not connected. Also, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next? This is quite confusing for me.

I turned off Airplane Mode. Now the status bar shows no signal and data is disabled, with battery at 80%. When I checked the SIM status, it says no SIM card detected in the phone. What should I do next? I'm worried because I don't know how to fix this.

I reseated the SIM card, and now the status bar shows a poor signal with 2G network, data is still disabled, and battery at 80%. The SIM card status now says it is active and working. What should I do next? I'm still a bit nervous about all these steps.

I turned on mobile data. The status bar now shows a poor signal with 2G network, data enabled, and battery at 80%. The network mode preference is set to 2G only. What should I do next? Should I change the network mode to 4G or 5G? I'm a bit unsure about this.

I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. The status bar now shows an excellent signal with 5G network, data enabled, and battery at 80%. However, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next? I'm feeling a bit frustrated because it still doesn't work.

The APN settings show the current APN name as "internet," but the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned ON. The messaging app only has permission for "phone," but not for "storage" or "sms." What should I do next? I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed with all these technical details.

I followed all the steps: I reset the APN settings, turned off Wi-Fi Calling, granted the messaging app permissions for storage and SMS, and restarted the phone. After the restart, the status bar shows excellent 5G signal with data enabled and battery at 80%. But unfortunately, my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. What else can we try? I'm really hoping to get this fixed soon.

After the restart, the APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL is now set. Wi-Fi Calling is still turned off. The messaging app has permissions for SMS, storage, and phone. However, the speed test failed due to no connection, and my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. It seems like there is no internet connection despite the good signal. What should I do next? I'm feeling quite frustrated with this.

The VPN is turned off, and Data Saver mode is also off. Airplane Mode is off, the SIM card is active, cellular connection is connected with excellent 5G signal, mobile data is enabled, and data roaming is enabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. However, the speed test still fails with no connection. What should I do next? I'm really hoping we can fix this soon.
Yes, I am currently abroad in France. Could this be causing the issue with sending MMS messages? What can we do about it?

I ran the speed test and now the connection is excellent with 275 Mbps. I also checked, and my messaging app can send MMS messages now. It looks like enabling roaming on my line fixed the problem. Thank you so much for your help!
Thank you very much for your patience and help throughout this process. I really appreciate it. I'll definitely send those pictures to my family now. Have a great day! ###STOP###

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

**Step 4: Restart the phone.** Use `reboot_device()`. The APN reset only takes effect after a restart.
